name: hint-layer
title: Coachmark and Hint Layer
description: One hint surface for a whole app, ported from the dashboard: anything with `data-hint` (or a `title`) shows a styled hint that follows the pointer, and a keyboard focus shows it under the element. Lines split on newlines; the first is bold when there are several.
